## Checklist
- [ ] `claude plugin validate .` passes
- [ ] Skills stay project-neutral (no hard-coded repos, boards, package managers or user paths)
- [ ] Skills and agents do not depend on other plugins being installed
- [ ] `version` in `plugins/nexus/.claude-plugin/plugin.json` bumped if behavior changed
- [ ] README tables updated if a skill or agent was added, renamed or removed
- [ ] No new `.mcp.json` servers, hooks or shell commands without an explanation above
